title: publishedDownload
responsibility: Check whether a same-origin public file is currently available with its expected media type.

inputs.name: publishedDownload.path
inputs.description: A root-relative public download URL. The browser requests it with HEAD.

inputs.name: publishedDownload.mediaType
inputs.description: The MIME type the server must return for the verified archive.

inputs.name: publishedDownload.request
inputs.description: Optional fetch implementation, for a deterministic request in tests.

outputs.name: publishedDownload
outputs.description: The same-origin available download path on HTTP 200 with the expected media type, or null when unavailable.
